newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks crawl higher on bargain-hunting.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks crawl higher on bargain-hunting.

text.p: Tokyo stocks crawled higher on bargain-hunting in the Thursday afternoon session, brokers said, aided by the yen's weakening against the dollar.
As of 0425 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was up 87.41 points or 0.44 percent at 19,929.39. June Nikkei futures added 60 points to 19,880.

"After the sharp fall on Wednesday, it wouldn't be surprising if there were a small rebound," a strategist at a second-tier brokerage said. "But the outlook on currencies is still blurred and the gains will probably be limited."
